explanation: Searched Mathlib/RingTheory/MvPowerSeries (Basic, Substitution, Rename, Derivative), Mathlib/RingTheory/PowerSeries/Substitution, FormalGroup/Basic, and Algebra/MvPolynomial for any lemma of the form `constantCoeff (subst a f) = constantCoeff f`. Mathlib only provides `MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff_subst` (giving `constantCoeff (subst a f) = finsum (fun d => coeff d f • constantCoeff (d.prod fun s e => a s ^ e))`), `MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff_subst_eq_zero` (requiring additionally `f.constantCoeff = 0`), the univariate `PowerSeries.constantCoeff_subst`/`constantCoeff_subst_eq_zero`, the degenerate `subst_zero_eq_C_constantCoeff`/`subst_zero_of_constantCoeff_zero`, `constantCoeff_map`, `constantCoeff_rename`, and `constantCoeff_comp_C`. None states the general result for arbitrary `f` when all `a i` have zero constant coefficient; deriving it from `constantCoeff_subst` requires the finsum vanishing argument (as in `constantCoeff_subst_eq_zero`'s proof), which is more than one or two lines of glue. Hence no duplicate or special case was found.
